name: Ice Golem
languages: understands the languages of its creator but can’t speak

traits.name: Icy Destruction
traits.text:
When the golem dies, it shatters in an explosion of
jagged ice shards, and each creature within 15 feet of it must make a DC
13 Dexterity saving throw, taking 10 (3d6) piercing damage and 7 (2d6)
cold damage on a failed save, or half as much damage on a successful one.

traits.name: Immutable Form
traits.text:
The golem is immune to any spell or effect that
would alter its form.

traits.name: Magic Resistance
traits.text:
The golem has advantage on saving throws against
spells and other magical effects.

traits.name: Magic Weapons
traits.text: The golem’s weapon attacks are magical.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.text: The golem can make two slam attacks.

actions.name: Slam
actions.text:
Melee Weapon Attack: +6 to hit, reach 10 ft., one target. Hit: 10
(2d6 + 3) bludgeoning damage plus 7 (2d6) cold damage.

actions.name: Cold Breath (Recharge 5–6)
actions.text:
The golem exhales a blast of freezing
wind in a 15-foot cone. Each creature in that area must make a DC 13
Dexterity saving throw, taking 18 (4d8) cold damage on a failed save, or
half as much damage on a successful one.
